query: I spent last weekend hiking the coastal trail near the border, and I found the cutest little stray cat curled up on a rock there, I ended up bringing her home and she’s already settled in so well, she even likes sleeping on my nightstand right next to my phone. Oh right, I’m overseas right now and my mobile data isn’t working at all, I checked and airplane mode is on, data saver mode is turned on too, and I have roaming disabled, can you help me figure out why I can’t get online?
